name: Erst-Holz
description: German online shop for solid-wood furniture, mainly children's, bunk and adult beds, plus bedroom, dining room, hallway and garden furniture, wooden toys and decorations. Its shipping page covers Germany and selected EU countries, with a surcharge schedule for islands.
description_es: Tienda online alemana de muebles de madera maciza, sobre todo camas infantiles, literas y para adultos, además de muebles de dormitorio, comedor, recibidor y jardín, juguetes de madera y decoración. Su página de envíos cubre Alemania y países de la UE, con tarifas especiales para islas.

ships_to.notes: Flat 3 EUR per household order on the German mainland, bulky items by freight to the curb. Island delivery is priced by weight from 15 EUR.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: The shipping page describes self pickup (Selbstabholung) with no shipping costs; the shop emails when the goods are ready.

shopping_notes: Shipping page states no delivery to Switzerland or other non-EU countries. Product pages in German.

sources.supports: Germany shipping rates, island surcharges, pickup, EU scope
